D14Digital

Master Clock

The clock source of the system

Generates a tempo from about 20 to 300 BPM and outputs four clocks from it, keeping sequencers and rhythm modules in sync.

  • Set the tempo by encoder or TAP
  • Can follow an external clock
  • Display for tempo and divisions
